tasks.title: Level 1's fighter and interceptor spawns, their legacy density and the station's rail reinforcements firing are pinned before anything changes
tasks.description:
Plan §2.9.1. New tests/integration/test_level1_fighter_spawns.gd pins every b.fighter()/b.interceptor() entry of Level1Director._build_sections() from data (section, trigger, offset, delay, formation type/size, aim_mode prop, free_after, movement set), plus per-section legacy peak concurrent fighters and legacy peak shots/s (aimed 1/0.8, forward 1/0.3, interceptor 1/0.09 per alive shooter), computed with tests/helpers/level1_drone_concurrency.gd (generalise it to take a lifetime function per kind). Add test_station_reinforcements.gd::test_rail_reinforcements_fire (every TOP fighter and LEFT/RIGHT interceptor fires >= 1 bullet within 2 s) and read the interceptor half-extent from the scene instead of the literal 37 (C13). No production code changes.

AttackController is not changed.
